[ASSISTANT_SAID] Brushing a cat's teeth helps prevent tartar buildup, reduce dental problems, and help with bad breath.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended tips for brushing a cat's teeth include using cat-specific toothbrush and toothpaste, starting slow, brushing in small circular motions, focusing on cheek teeth, brushing back sides, and rewarding good behavior.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested brushing Luna's teeth daily or at least 3-4 times a week for consistency.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended creating a pet calendar to track health care routines and appointments.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested setting reminders for appointments and routine tasks, keeping a pet health journal, using a pet care app, and creating a routine checklist.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended flea medications include topical treatments like Frontline, Advantix, and Capstar, oral medications like Comfortis and Trifexis, and flea preventatives like Nexgard and Seresto.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised consulting with a veterinarian before starting any new flea medication for Max.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested interactive cat toys like food puzzle toys, treat dispensers, hide-and-seek toys, problem-solving toys, and sensory toys for Luna.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended washing cat bedding in hot water with mild detergent, avoiding fabric softener, drying on high heat, and washing regularly at least once a week.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided a list of tips for washing and drying cat bedding properly, including checking care labels and ensuring bedding is completely dry before use.
